seed_scope: reset per video; independent of video iteration order
geometry: Euclidean on raw valid encoded frame vectors, before cosine normalization
initialization: k-means++, one probability-weighted candidate per center
tolerance_definition: sum of squared center shifts <= tol * mean(per-coordinate population variance)
convergence: unchanged assignments after empty-cluster repair, or tolerance
restart_selection: smallest final nearest-center SSE in float64; earliest restart on exact ties
empty_cluster: relocate a farthest residual point from a cluster with count > 1; original point order breaks ties
precision: float32 encoder output promoted to float64 for clustering, translation centered for stability; centers cast to float32 for original cosine scoring
short_video: L <= 32: no k-means; exact valid_length_pool singleton fallback, preserving original vectors
stage_concurrency: video encoder and clustering execute sequentially; up to 8 videos cluster concurrently
